SpaceRacer audio - turbine-2026-10-06

External source sounds are published under CC0 1.0:
https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/
Published licenses checked 6 October 2026. Commercial use, processing and
redistribution are permitted without required attribution. Credits retained.

Sojan - Sci-Fi Engine Loop, Freesound #407540
https://freesound.org/people/Sojan/sounds/407540/
Recorded printer cooling down; used for the idle mechanical layer.

minian89 - jet_engine.wav, Freesound #152509
https://freesound.org/people/minian89/sounds/152509/
Author-created jet synthesis in Pure Data. Used for drive/boost loops and
boost, launch and warp effects. This source is synthesized, not a field recording.

Kenney - Impact Sounds 1.0, 19 December 2019
https://kenney.nl/assets/impact-sounds
impactMetal_heavy_000..004.ogg: contacts, sentry, launches, railgun, explosions.
impactPunch_heavy_000..004.ogg: landing transients.
Original license retained in tools/audio_sources/KENNEY-LICENSE.txt.

Processing: mono conversion, filtering, crossfaded loops, envelope shaping,
level balancing, layering. Air, scrape, bass, electronics and race signals also
use original procedural synthesis. No generative audio service was used.

Exact downloaded-source hashes and source URLs: tools/audio_sources/sources.json.
Per-output hashes and source mapping: assets/audio/racer/manifest.json.
Rebuild: python tools/render_racer_audio.py (numpy and ffmpeg required).
Source project code is covered by the repository LICENSE.
Published licensing has been checked; original ownership is not independently verified.
